title: Implementation report artifact (contract 1.0.0)
description: Parsed representation of an implementation-report.md artifact. Evidence must be real execution output, never fabricated.

approvedTaskPlan.description: The exact approved task-plan revision this implementation used.

revision.description: Revision number of the approved task-plan artifact.

hash.description: Full sha256 of the approved task-plan artifact.

taskResults.description: One outcome record per planned task, same ids.

metadata.description: Machine-identifiable provenance of this artifact revision.

artifactType.description: Must equal the contract's artifact type.

contractVersion.description: Semantic version of the artifact contract this document follows.

changeId.description: The factory change id this artifact belongs to.

revision.description: Revision number the extension will record for this candidate.

status.description: complete only when the document is ready for validation and review.

updatedAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp of the last edit.

requiredText.description: Free-form section content; must not be empty.

nullableText.description: Section content; null only when the documented not-applicable marker was used.

taskResult.description: The actual outcome of one planned task (### TASK-###: title).

id.description: Must be a task id from the approved plan.

title.description: Task title from the approved plan.

status.description: Actual outcome; COMPLETED requires real evidence.

evidence.description: Command(s) run + key output proving the outcome; descriptive text for non-completed outcomes.

description.description: Optional narrative of what actually happened.
